I'm checking the finding about Last Updated Date on update, which concerns other stories, so within this story I can only revise its own tasks. The create story already handles setting that date on create, and new tasks should start as Open with the backend setting Creation and Last Updated on create, so I'm weighing whether any task changes are actually needed to keep the story consistent.

I'm settling on the Open status for new tasks, so the create-task endpoint should set status Open, Creation Date, Last Updated Date, and leave Completion Date empty. The form fields don't need a status field, and the edit form belongs to another story, so I'll limit the changes to the endpoint task and the acceptance criteria.
